R reduces Tumble cooldown and grants one second invisibility on Q, buying a spacing window. Rageblade can be tested for Silver Bolts delivery rather than presumed to copy the third-hit counter.
opportunities.requiredState: Same target for consecutive W actions; finite Rageblade ramp and R active.
opportunities.failure: Low AD and attack commitment can lose damage before the next Silver Bolts trigger.
opportunities.test: Separate physical Q, magic item packets and true W at matched consecutive attacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Magic penetration does not improve Q physical damage or W true damage.

opportunities.name: Condemn frost pocket
opportunities.objective: Use Q Spellblade slowing to hold a wall angle for Condemn and three real hits.
opportunities.mechanic: Iceborn rewards the actual post-Tumble attack with a frost field; E only gains its extra damage and stun when the target hits terrain. BotRK adds a current-health physical on-hit and three-attack slow, while Terminus supplies finite mixed penetration/resistance stacks. R/Night Hunter improve pursuit after the controlled pocket.
opportunities.requiredState: A real wall behind the target and same-target attack access; item stacks start recorded.
opportunities.failure: The frost field cannot create terrain or rescue a failed E angle; armor spending lowers carry output.
opportunities.test: Record E wall success and time to three same-target attacks versus a moving opponent.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Iceborn slows do not make every Condemn a wall stun.

ruledOut.reason: W requires three consecutive actions against an enemy; the source does not establish independent Silver Bolts counters on bolts.

unknowns: Q spell-effects helper remains unresolved; Rageblade/Dusk on-hit effects versus W counters require live validation.

opportunities.name: Gloom attack reach
opportunities.objective: Test a charged extended attack as the safe consumer of E-applied Gloom.
opportunities.mechanic: E applies Gloom; an attack consumes it for 0.25 AP magic damage and reduces Doom cooldown by 25%. RFC extends one energized attack, while Lich Bane supplies a separate attack packet after E. Nashor asks whether continued attacks are productive; W shield gives an escape buffer and Q provides an alternative Gloom consumer.
opportunities.requiredState: E connects, RFC is charged and one attack occurs before Q/W consumes the same Gloom.
opportunities.failure: Crit/attack speed spending weakens spells and pursuit can expose Vex after the charged hit.
opportunities.test: Log attack range, Gloom damage and Doom timer after one E-attack versus E-Q.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated on-hits or three Hail attacks do not consume one Gloom mark three times.

opportunities.name: Fear-fed dive recovery
opportunities.objective: Turn first-contact fear into an ally vulnerability window before seeking an R reset.
opportunities.mechanic: Doom empowers the next basic spell with fear; R itself is a marked dive with a conditional takedown reset. Mandate marks on the basic-spell fear, while Cryptbloom can heal around a damaged target death and Cosmic grants speed on magic contact. W AP shield and Zhonya protect the first arrival as the team finishes the mark.
opportunities.requiredState: Doom ready; R mark hits, arrive with W fear and allies can follow within the mark window.
opportunities.failure: No first takedown means neither reset nor death heal; defensive slots can lose the burst race.
opportunities.test: Time R arrival, W fear/Mandate, allied finish and Cryptbloom heal with Doom ready versus unavailable.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R takedown reset requires its own mark window; any unrelated later kill is insufficient.

ruledOut.reason: Passive documents timed recharge and 25% reduction on Gloom consumption; basic haste does not establish direct passive recharge scaling.

unknowns: R damage and takedown-window tooltips remain cross-referenced. RFC delivery, Gloom timer and Mandate interaction require live checks.

opportunities.name: Siphon movement attack
opportunities.objective: Explore repeated attack contact during the augmented Q shield and speed window.
opportunities.mechanic: Q grants an AP shield and a next attack dealing magic damage with 0.5 AP plus AD; augmentation multiplies shield by 1.6 and grants 30% move speed. Dusk and Dawn and Nashor supply item attack packets while Cosmic adds magic-contact movement. W provides a delayed stun only if the victim remains inside 1.25 seconds.
opportunities.requiredState: Earn Q augment through finite fragments and complete the attack within four seconds.
opportunities.failure: Extra attacks leave W zone or expose Viktor after the 2.5-second shield expires.
opportunities.test: Separate Q cast, empowered magic attack and item packets while measuring shield duration/attack uptime.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated on-hits do not mean two Q empowerment consumptions.

opportunities.name: Growing storm cleanup
opportunities.objective: Test continued magic debuff contact as an upgraded storm grows after finite takedowns.
opportunities.mechanic: R lasts 6.5 seconds, deals initial plus per-second AP magic damage, and its upgrade extends size/duration three seconds per damaged-champion death up to six times. Bloodletter and Liandry reward confirmed damage contact while Malignance tests ultimate-ground interaction. Cosmic supports manual storm shepherding and E aftershock if augmented.
opportunities.requiredState: Record earned R upgrade, target path and actual takedowns/extension count.
opportunities.failure: Storm leaves targets or no deaths occur; the supposed cleanup ramp never starts.
opportunities.test: Count R ticks and extension events at zero versus two takedowns, isolating Hatefog refresh.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A six-extension cap does not grant all six extensions at fight start.

ruledOut.reason: R upgrade specifies three-second extension per damaged-target death with a maximum of six events.

unknowns: Dusk Q duplication and R item-proc cadence need logs; upgraded E/W/R must be earned from recorded fragments.

opportunities.name: Magic bite recovery
opportunities.objective: Test AP and magic penetration as a direct way to improve Q damage-based healing.
opportunities.mechanic: Q deals 1 AP plus 1.2 AD and max-health magic damage, healing for a rank-scaled fraction dealt. Passive adds AP/AD magic on-hit and heals below half health; Visage enhances that self recovery. Nashor supports actual attacks and R has three channel attacks with full damage-based healing, whose item inheritance is separately tested.
opportunities.requiredState: Actual MR, health threshold and Q rank fixed; E covers exposure before low-health recovery.
opportunities.failure: Healing reduction, burst above the threshold or missed R prevents the intended recovery.
opportunities.test: Log Q damage/heal versus MR, passive heals above/below 50% and R item packets separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AD scaling on Q/R does not make their documented damage physical.

opportunities.name: Blood-hunt launch angle
opportunities.objective: Use conditional movement to extend R reach while retaining a protected fear exit.
opportunities.mechanic: R leap distance scales with movement speed; W gains approach speed toward low-health champions and an active hunt can apply the passive toward the nearest champion. Stridebreaker supplies a short access tool; Dead Man and Swifties test approach speed, while E damage reduction and fear support a survivable landing. BotRK and Sundered Sky reward subsequent actual attacks.
opportunities.requiredState: Record W active/target health, direction and actual movement speed at R launch.
opportunities.failure: W direction restrictions or frontline collision sends R into the wrong target.
opportunities.test: Measure R range and first collision at identical target paths with W inactive, active and below-half target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Out-of-combat or hunt movement is not guaranteed during every combat direction.

ruledOut.reason: Passive summary says triples below 25%, but retained tooltip states 250%; the conflict prevents asserting an exact triple heal.

unknowns: Eternal Hunger low-health multiplier conflicts between summary and symbolic tooltip. R attacks and Q proc inheritance require packet logs; AD statFormula=2 is retained.

opportunities.name: Mana-surge stun attack
opportunities.objective: Test a deliberate energized attack after E stun as a resource-positive trade.
opportunities.mechanic: Mana Surge restores twice the non-champion amount on a champion attack, on a sixteen-second clock reduced by kills. E stuns up to 2.25 seconds depending on flight distance; RFC extends one attack and Lich Bane adds a separate magic packet after a cast. AP still strengthens Q/W, while Cosmic can support retreat after the hit.
opportunities.requiredState: Passive and energized attack ready; E connects and attacker can reach within the stun.
opportunities.failure: Approaching to attack forfeits artillery safety and wastes the low-AD crit slot.
opportunities.test: Compare E-one-attack-Q with spell-only poke, logging mana restored, attack range and damage taken.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: RFC extends the charged attack, not Xerath Q/E cast range.

opportunities.name: Artillery hit ladder
opportunities.objective: Preserve R hit accuracy while testing debuffs around its per-hit damage growth.
opportunities.mechanic: R fires four to six times and adds AP-scaled damage per champion hit, so later shots depend on actual earlier connections. Horizon reveals targets struck from at least 600 range; Malignance can test Hatefog/MR reduction for R damage and Bloodletter tests debuff ramp. W center slow and E stun help prepare the channel rather than assuming every shot lands.
opportunities.requiredState: Record R rank, shot count, hits and distance; a safe ten-second channel is possible.
opportunities.failure: An interrupted channel or moving target causes misses and removes the claimed shot ladder.
opportunities.test: Measure shot-by-shot damage and MR debuff after a miss versus a connected opening hit.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Horizon current catalog is a reveal effect, not an assumed generic damage amplification.

ruledOut.idea: Passive restores mana on every attack
ruledOut.reason: Mana Surge has a sixteen-second cooldown with kill reductions; repeated attacks alone do not reset it.

unknowns: R hit-ladder scope across different victims and Hatefog refresh need live validation; charged-attack item set is a narrow experiment.

opportunities.name: Mixed-blade penetration ramp
opportunities.objective: Test whether finite mixed penetration repays reduced crit investment during an E window.
opportunities.mechanic: Passive every second attack deals half magic damage; W and R split physical/magic damage. Terminus provides finite armor/MR penetration and defensive stacks through champion attacks, while Rageblade/BotRK support attack packets. E lasts five seconds and repeats a share of documented attack/ability damage, so proc inclusion remains a separate question.
opportunities.requiredState: Fix crit cap, initial Terminus/Rageblade stacks and complete attacks inside one E duration.
opportunities.failure: Ramp occurs after the target disengages or the return body is threatened.
opportunities.test: Separate physical/magic packets and E repeat with zero versus recorded pre-stacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Item on-hit damage is not automatically included in E repeat merely because it accompanied an attack.

opportunities.name: Cleave shield duel
opportunities.objective: Use a health/AD route to protect repeated W hits during a bounded spirit trade.
opportunities.mechanic: W hits grant an AD[statFormula=2] shield increased per champion struck; Visage enhances self shields. Bloodmail gives bounded health-to-AD and missing-health AD, supporting that shield if its retained flag is confirmed. Trinity supplies an actual attack Spellblade and Sundered Sky tests first-attack healing while Q/R provide access.
opportunities.requiredState: Observed AD/health fixed, W hits one versus two champions and E return body stays safe.
opportunities.failure: Reduced crit damage/attack speed may lose the trade despite larger shields.
opportunities.test: Log W shield per victim, damage and health retained over a five-second E exchange.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W shield target count does not make all W damage or health scalings multiply freely.

ruledOut.idea: Full armor penetration benefits all Yone damage
ruledOut.reason: Passive/W/R include magic portions; armor penetration affects only physical packets and cannot be applied to the whole mixed total.

unknowns: Q crit and crit-to-AD excess conversion use special formulas. W retained WDamage helper differs from rendered percent-health tooltip; do not substitute it. E damage ledger needs live reconciliation.

opportunities.name: Best-friend AP attack grant
opportunities.objective: Explore AP spending for the ally on-hit grant while retaining an eligible heal/shield buff.
opportunities.mechanic: Best Friend Q grants five seconds of 0.05 AP on-hit damage, enhanced by the ally crit chance, and W grants 0.03 AP healing per ally hit. E supplies AP-scaled attack speed/shield; Ardent adds its own ally attack buff when E shields. Deathcap/Staff test AP investment versus ordinary support power, retaining the quest.
opportunities.requiredState: Actual Best Friend with recorded attack rate and crit chance; land Q and shield before the attack window.
opportunities.failure: A non-Best-Friend attachment or missed Q removes the on-hit grant and expensive AP fails to pay.
opportunities.test: Count ally Q-granted on-hit and W healing packets over five seconds at fixed ally crit/attack rate.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Buying crit on Yuumi does not supply the ally crit chance used by Q.

opportunities.name: Chapter shield relay
opportunities.objective: Stagger E during the five R waves to keep attack-speed and ally protection useful.
opportunities.mechanic: R launches five healing waves over 3.5 seconds and excess healing becomes shields; E can be cast during channel, adds shield/attack speed and restores missing-mana-scaled mana while attached. Moonstone can chain eligible ally heals/shields and Helia asks whether Q/R damage charges are consumed by these wave heals. Mikael can remove eligible control so the carrier moves the channel.
opportunities.requiredState: Attached to an ally, R aimed at actual allies/enemies and E timed against incoming damage.
opportunities.failure: Attaching mid-channel locks direction; healing full targets may create shields that expire unused.
opportunities.test: Log five wave heals/shields, Moonstone chains, Helia charge consumption and E mana restoration.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Mikael does not remove airborne or suppression, and each wave is not free stored Helia charges.

ruledOut.reason: Yuumi Q grants its own described ally on-hit; attachment does not state that owner Nashor or Spellblade transfers.

unknowns: Best Friend R heal multiplier is unresolved. R/E buff refresh, excess-heal conversion and Helia/Moonstone inheritance need live checks; friendship is finite.

opportunities.name: Marked attack filler
opportunities.objective: Test one real attack between shadow abilities and Death Mark expiry.
opportunities.mechanic: R records a three-second damage window; Q/shadows supply physical hits and W returns energy when matching abilities hit. Trinity supports one actual post-cast attack, BotRK adds a current-health packet and passive adds conditional magic damage below half health. The mark repeat must be logged without assuming every proc counts.
opportunities.requiredState: R mark active, finite energy, target below half for passive and Spellblade ready.
opportunities.failure: The attack delays a multi-shuriken hit or exposes Zed before escape.
opportunities.test: Compare R-Q-E versus the same sequence plus one attack, isolating passive/item and final mark packets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W shadow Q casts do not themselves consume attack Spellblade.

opportunities.name: Slash-driven shadow recycle
opportunities.objective: Use actual Zed E champion contact to shorten W and produce a second escape/attack angle.
opportunities.mechanic: E by Zed reduces W cooldown three seconds per champion hit; shadow E adds slow but overlapping slashes deal no extra damage. Shojin haste and physical Cleaver pressure test a longer exchange, with Eclipse and Deaths Dance supporting survival. E contact and W energy refund must be earned, not assumed from every shadow.
opportunities.requiredState: Record energy and W state; Zed own E reaches one or more champions safely.
opportunities.failure: Only the shadow reaches the target, so the planned W cooldown reduction fails.
opportunities.test: Log W timer after Zed E versus shadow-only E and count energy refunds for matched Q hits.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Overlapping E slashes do not each deal full damage or each independently grant the own-E W refund.

ruledOut.reason: Passive retained percent-health magic damage is conditional/unresolved, with no documented AP ratio to support an AP Zed kit claim.

unknowns: Passive GameCalculationConditional is unresolved; Death Mark item/pet damage ledger and AD statFormula=2 need live reconciliation. No mana pools on Energy.

opportunities.name: Rewind attack interlude
opportunities.objective: Test one Spellblade attack between a first bomb and the rewind-assisted second bomb.
opportunities.mechanic: Q waits three seconds unless a second bomb on the same unit detonates it and stuns. W removes ten seconds from other basic cooldowns; Lich Bane rewards an actual attack between the casts, and Nashor tests continued attacks during the double-bomb stun. E controls the approach while AP powers bombs and R revival healing.
opportunities.requiredState: First bomb attached, W ready and the attack cannot delay second Q past detonation.
opportunities.failure: The attack makes the second bomb miss or expire, losing the stun and burst.
opportunities.test: Compare Q-W-Q with Q-attack-W-Q at the same Q cooldown, tracking stun and item packets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W does not reset Spellblade item cooldown or the ultimate.

opportunities.name: Chronoshift recovery escort
opportunities.objective: Test movement and ally-heal delivery around an actual triggered revival.
opportunities.mechanic: E gives up to 99% movement speed or slow for 2.5 seconds. R marks an ally for five seconds and on lethal damage revives after three seconds stasis with 2 AP healing; Staff/Moonstone can be tested for eligibility on that heal. Shurelya helps the revived ally exit, while Mikael addresses eligible control.
opportunities.requiredState: R actually triggers on the intended ally, and allies remain nearby after the three-second stasis.
opportunities.failure: No lethal trigger yields no revive heal; a waiting enemy immediately kills the returning ally.
opportunities.test: Record revive heal and Staff/Moonstone activation, then escape distance with timed E/Shurelya.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Casting Chronoshift is not an immediate heal or shield and cannot immediately trigger every heal item.

ruledOut.idea: Basic haste resets Chronoshift via W
ruledOut.reason: W only reduces other basic ability cooldowns by ten seconds, excluding R.

unknowns: Passive tooltip is an unresolved localization token; passive summary only establishes experience transfer. Revive-heal item eligibility and double-bomb Spellblade timing need live tests.
